A single normal login at /rest/user/login succeeded (200) and returned an authenticated session bound to bid=1 and umail=admin@juice-sh.op, confirming the administrator role. Subsequent session-identity read (/rest/user/whoami) returned an empty user object, and permitted account views (/rest/user/1, /rest/user/account) returned 500 unexpected-path errors, so no further account data was obtained. No authentication bypass, enumeration, or data modification performed. Credentials and token not reproduced.
